candidates.prompt: Create ONE full-body 2D pixel-art animation frame immediately BEFORE the upward punch in reference 1, of the exact same Luna Armor Ultraman Arc. Fixed side view facing right. Keep BOTH boots in exactly the same ground positions and spacing as reference 1, same scale, pelvis and body proportions. Slightly bend knees to load the strike. The FAR-SIDE RIGHT hand is a closed fist drawn back beside the lower abdomen, ready to rise upward in the next frame; the NEAR-SIDE LEFT hand also remains a closed protective fist by the abdomen, both arms clearly connected and distinct. Do not open either palm or punch horizontally yet. Preserve identical swept silver crest, yellow eyes, cyan-blue shoulder/chest armor, round blue chest light and two circular wrist armors, red and silver limbs of references. Complete whole character with feet and armor tips fully visible and generous margin; do not cut or rotate limbs. Isolated transparent background, no opponent, sparks, beams, shadows, ground, text or motion effects. Cohesive crisp pixel-art sprite.

Create ONE full-body 2D pixel-art animation frame immediately AFTER the upward punch in reference 1, of the exact same Luna Armor Ultraman Arc. Fixed side view facing right. Keep BOTH boots in exactly the same ground positions and spacing as reference 1, and maintain same head, torso, hip height, and whole-body proportions. The FAR-SIDE RIGHT closed fist is still raised in front of and above the face but has moved ONLY SLIGHTLY lower and closer to the body as the same arm begins to retract after the uppercut. Its elbow bends slightly more and the forearm still points clearly upward; do not make a horizontal punch or drop the fist to the waist. The NEAR-SIDE LEFT closed fist stays protecting the abdomen. Preserve both complete arms, two distinct circular wrist armors, swept silver crest, yellow eyes, cyan-blue armor, circular blue chest light and red-silver limbs of the references. Whole character with crest, both hands, boots and armor tips fully visible, generous margin; no opponent, sparks, motion effects, beams, text, ground or shadow. Crisp cohesive pixel art on genuinely transparent background.

review.method: 原生1254原图逐张目视，PIL真alpha/SHA与同坐标底部区域测量；未运行Godot。底部区域为y>=1080按x=650分近远腿的alpha128包围盒，不等同骨骼标注。
review.identity: 两张保留银冠黄眼蓝青胸肩甲圆胸灯红银四肢，完整双臂双腿，无明显错角色。近亮左臂护腹、远侧右臂蓄拳/回收身份可追踪。
review.phase01: 两只闭拳分居腹前两侧，轻屈膝、肩头下降，替代旧张掌的方向成立。远侧右腕甲被拳/躯干遮住，只能看到部分蓝色外缘，不能确认完整圆面造型；不将遮挡等同断肢，也不宣称双腕甲清晰通过。
review.phase03: 右拳仍在额头前方高位，肘更弯、前臂仍向上，近拳护腹且双圆腕甲可辨；相对02确为同臂下收，并非横拳。拳已降至额头附近，不严格满足整只拳高于脸部，故不称完全遵从提示词。
review.feet_scale: 03脚位与02接近；01近鞋底由02的1201到1192，约上移9原像素，不能称完全固定支撑脚。01屈膝而头冠降低属于姿态变化，但头身/骨段尚未独立定量验收，禁止以包围盒高度变化直接判缩放正确。
review.continuity: 01腹前闭拳→02高位上挑→03高位回收语义成立；01到02跨越较大，缺渐伸中间相，静帧不能证明实速顺滑。旧00入蓄、03到旧04宽站距及后续回架仍未解决，不得把三张关键帧当完整七相动作。
review.alpha: 两张均RGBA并有真实透明像素，主要alpha>=128人物有边距；低alpha非零轮廓均触左/底边，继续保留噪点问题，未阈值清理原图。
not_verified: 主游戏真实输入和实际判定

next_step: 先复核远腕遮挡、支撑鞋9px漂移能否在统一全帧配准容差内接受，以及起手/收招整帧衔接；不切肢、不单移鞋，未完成前不安装或开放装甲。
